seeds_note: Issue #682's MIM-H04EN EHS Wi-Fi kit and its SAC_EHS_MONO heat pump, from the reporter's 0.35.0 diagnostics. Every rep is verbatim from that dump (serials and ids redacted, the OCF device id replaced by a placeholder). Each batch is rebuilt from the dump's parsed resources, so its order is not captured; the leading {href: /device/0} collection entry is what the kit's batch carried, since the dump shows it parsed as a resource. subdeviceIdList is redacted in diagnostics; it is restored as the heat pump's placeholder id, which the dump's materialized subdevice key and /oic/res prefixes both name.
